text:
Jules: Quick thread 1 1 re onboarding UX choice: we have two comps compact bottom strip vs right rail checklist. Which do folks prefer for 'resume where you left off' flows? Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz/onboard-resume-variants

Priya: I'm leaning right rail for discoverability on larger screens, but worried it pushes main canvas content. Bottom strip feels less invasive but could be ignored.

Noah: Data note: small cohort tests showed click-through to sample projects was 3.2x with a persistent rail vs 1.1x for ephemeral modals. So rail wins for activation.

Elena: Accessibility concerns for the rail: screen reader order and focus trap when expanded. Also contrast on the 'Resume' pill needs +4.5 ratio.

Tom: Implementation-wise, bottom strip is simpler (global header + portal area). Rail requires layout shifts unless we reserve space in the shell. Could use the rail collapsed by default to avoid reflow.

Jules: Good points. UX tradeoff: high activation vs minimal layout impact. What about a hybrid? Collapsed rail (icon+progress) that expands to a checklist overlay when clicked.

Priya: Hybrid sounds good. Microcopy suggestion: top line "Continue your setup" rather than "Complete onboarding". CTA text: 'Resume' or 'Try samples' depending on state.

Noah: Agree on copy. Also: add subtle inline help under each checklist item, e.g., 'Add a sample project (2 min)' so expectations are set.

Elena: A11y checklist: 1) keyboard focus order: rail icon should be reachable as part of main nav tab sequence; 2) when expanded, trap focus inside overlay; 3) provide `aria-live` updates for progress changes; 4) respect `prefers-reduced-motion`.

Tom: Dev notes: we'll persist progress flags per-account in Users KV and backfill if we detect older sessions. API shape: `POST /v1/onboard/progress {"flags": ["sample_added","billing_skipped"]}`. We'll emit events but debounce writes.

Jules: Event schema proposal: `onboard.resume.click`, `onboard.item.complete` (props: `item_id`, `duration_ms`), `onboard.dismiss`. Capture `variant: hybrid-rail-collapsed` for A/B analysis.

Priya: Also add a telemetry field `ui_entrypoint` (e.g., "console-home", "projects-list") so we can compare placement effectiveness.

Elena: Screen reader copy: when the rail expands announce "Onboarding checklist expanded. X of Y items complete." Use `aria-atomic` for that region.

Noah: Visual detail: progress dot size should be 8px not 6px to improve tap targets on touch. Also ensure hit target >= 44px.

Jules: Good. One UX question: should completing the checklist auto-collapse the rail and show a confetti micro-anim? If yes, tie to `prefers-reduced-motion` for an accessible alternative.

Priya: Confetti ok as long as it's subtle and skippable. Maybe an inline checkmark + small celebratory text is enough.

Tom: I'll prototype the collapsed-to-expanded interactions and include focus management. Plan: spike this week, PR next. I'll include a small feature flag `onboard.hybrid_rail` for rollout.

OnboardingBot: Tip: remind users who abandon after item 1 with a 'Continue where you left off' email after 48 hours if `email_opt_in=true`.

Jules: Thanks all. I'll update the figma with the hybrid behavior, add copy variants, and create the A/B plan doc. Tagging @Tom for the spike. If no objections by EOD I'll move to handoff.

Priya: :+1: love the hybrid plan.

Elena: :white_check_mark: added a11y notes on Figma.

Tom: On it. Will post WIP link when ready.
